analysis_stage: post-reveal exploratory moment realization on existing N100/N400; no new MC and no change to the N900 width target
construction: m'_r(t)=sum_j (-t)^j*r!/(2^j*j!*(r-2j)!)*m_(r-2j). Starting at t=0, find the first PSD boundary of H3(t)=[m'_(i+j)]_i,j=0..3 within 0<=t<=1. Require H2 positive definite, H3 flat rank3, three real distinct centers, positive weights, and reproduction of m0..m6. Otherwise report failure rather than change atom count or model family.
model: sum_a=1..3 w_a Normal(center_a,t), center-ordered; maximum common Gaussian variance permitted by the truncated positive moment problem
uncertainty: Refit normalization, first PSD boundary, three centers and weights inside every original common-batch LOO; retain full covariance. Source sizes are independent blocks. No independent validation claim for unused moments from the same data.
numerical_gate: Standardized H2 minimum eigenvalue >1e-10; H3 boundary absolute minimum eigenvalue <1e-9; three-center moment reconstruction max absolute residual <1e-8. A gate failure is an unresolved construction, not a request to scan another family.
boundary: Three atoms are a positive truncated-moment representation, not three fields or proof of Gaussian components in the full signed profile. The existing finite-support rank-step profile is not literally an unbounded Gaussian mixture. No window, component-number, or mixture-family scan. N900 is not read.
